content:
Jamal: heads up — after upgrading from @redwood/sdk 0.25.2 -> 0.27.0 our chat streaming call returns 404. Used to work yesterday. Error shows 'route not found'. Anyone seen this?

Maya (support): sorry you're hitting this, can you paste the request snippet + x-request-id from the error response? any chance you changed package versions on CI only? :thinking_face: 

Jamal: repro snippet below (local node):
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.chat.stream({ session: 'abc-123', model: 'redwood/e21' });
```
Error: 404 Not Found - route 'chat.stream' not found (x-request-id: 01F7X2YQ9Z-abc)

Maya (support): thanks — routing that to devex and eng-oncall. Can you confirm package-lock/yarn.lock was updated and not mixing 0.25/0.27? Also which env (hosted/dedicated/private)?

Jamal: hosted. lockfile updated. We rolled the version bump in our CI pipeline only — local dev still on 0.25. Repro'd in a fresh container.

Ravi (devex): quick check — 0.27 introduced rename of the streaming method on the client in the TS types? I remember a change where `chat.stream` was moved under `chat.streams` in an internal refactor (but server kept `chat.create`). Let me check changelog.

Lin (eng-oncall): looking at logs for x-request-id 01F7X2YQ9Z-abc — request reached routing service and returned 404 from the control-plane compatibility layer. It attempted to find a route key `chat.stream` -> none matched. Looks like client is sending a new route key that isn't published to hosted yet.

Maya (support): can you try switching to `chat.create` or use the non-streaming path as a short-term workaround? Also, does `client.chat.stream` fail for you on 0.25?

Jamal: `chat.create` works fine for non-streaming. Need streaming though. Repro steps I used:
1) Dockerfile: node:18, set RW_KEY
2) npm i @redwood/sdk@0.27.0
3) run the snippet above -> 404

Ravi (devex): I pulled 0.27.0 types — there was a rename of the param `session` -> `chat_session` in the new API shape but the control plane wasn't yet accepting the new route key in hosted (we gated rollout). That would explain route/key mismatch: client emits `chat.stream.v2` or similar but router doesn't have it.

Lin (eng-oncall): confirmed — there is a partial rollout in prod that expects clients to use `chat_session` param and route key `chat.stream.v2`. 0.27.0 _may_ be emitting the v2 route by default. We should confirm exactly which route key your client is sending (devex, can we add debug header?).

Ravi (devex): quick workaround for customers: pin @redwood/sdk to 0.25.x until rollout completes OR set the SDK env var `REDWOOD_CLIENT_ROUTE=legacy` (undocumented but available) to force old route keys until we finish the rollout. I'll draft a public support note.

Maya (support): Jamal — can you try `npm i @redwood/sdk@0.25.3` in CI, redeploy and confirm streaming resumes? If yes we can mark as regression and escalate billing/incident if needed.

Jamal: downgraded to 0.25.3 in CI and streaming works again. Thanks — please let me know when 0.27 rollout is completed.

Lin (eng-oncall): filed internal incident RN-786: 'TS SDK 0.27 default route keys not available in hosted — causes 404 for chat.stream'. Dev runtime will gate the 0.27 route key rollout and add compatibility header. Escalating to runtime team.

Ravi (devex): I'll draft the advisory and include the temporary env var + downgrade instructions and repro steps. Action items: (1) DevEx publish advisory (2) Runtime add compatibility flag (3) Release 0.27.1 that defaults to legacy route until rollout done.

Maya (support): thanking you all. Jamal — leaving this open, ping us if you see any billing/duplicate tokens or retries while you were troubleshooting. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-17T15:12:08Z - rollback to @redwood/sdk@0.25.3 for jamal/team-frontend (CI) succeeded.

Jamal: confirmed CI rollback stable. Appreciate the quick help.
